objective: Freeze prompt-only RMS/softmax range policy as useful heuristics and split attention d128 into separate seed-mechanism research.
harness_change_rationale: The existing seeds arm can test data-derived seed configs. A new combined seeds_plus_range_prompt arm may require harness work if it is not already available.

materiality.interpretation: Treat geomean perf deltas under 5% and wall-time deltas under 20% as noise.

attention_d128_prompt_only.reason: Prompt-only d128 guidance found faster kernels in iteration 11 but regressed wall time and compile total; iteration 12 no-guidance lost the perf win. Do not continue loose prompt-only d128 narrowing.

attention_d64_prompt_only.reason: No data-backed prompt-only win; keep blocked/no-guidance.

attention_d128_seed_mechanism.if_gate_passes: Design and validate a constrained-candidate or seed-injection mechanism on held-out attention and non-attention shapes.
attention_d128_seed_mechanism.if_gate_fails: Close attention d128 mechanism research for this loop and keep frozen RMS/softmax only.

validation_design.frozen_policy_iteration_13_runs: None required unless the first-round prompt mechanism changes.
